combo1.title: Genta + Dealings into Saryuja, Grapha Overlord & Fog Blade
combo1.description: A full Dark World combo line from Genta + Dark World Dealings, through Dugares and Saryuja Skull Dread, into a board of Grapha Dragon Overlord, Knightmare Gryphon, Phantom Knights Rusty Bardiche, Selene, and Fog Blade. Heads-up: this line uses Knightmare Gryphon, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.
